newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ASkyB may have other carriers - News.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ASkyB may have other carriers - News.

text.p: Rupert Murdoch said on Tuesday that News Corp Ltd's U.S. satellite television ASkyB joint venture may include other telecommunications carriers besides MCI Telecommunications Inc.
"In America, we have American Sky Broadcasting, with MCI at the moment, and the venture may include other telephone companies in due course," Murdoch told the annual meeting.
Murdoch said American Sky Broadcasting (ASkyB) would be launched with over 200 channels of television by late next year.
"We have great hopes for that (ASkyB)," said Murdoch, News' chairman and chief executive officer.

"There are competitors who are now growing very quickly. We are not frightened of them. We think the competition is not the other one of two satellite provides but the whole cable cable industry," Murdoch said.
Murdoch said it would not be cheap to start the U.S. satellite televison business.
"We think the prospects are very good, but time will tell and it will not be a cheap undertaking, because we have had to buy our own satellites," he said.
